title: Medical Representative
summary: A medical representative visits doctors, chemists and stockists in a territory to explain a pharma company's medicines and grow prescriptions and sales. The role sits in the field sales team of a therapy division and reports to an area or district manager.
dailyDuties: Call on doctors from the master call list and detail key brands
Visit chemists to check stock and prescription uptake
Collect orders and stock statements from stockists
Plan the week's tour across headquarter and outstation towns
File the daily call report and expenses in the company app
Attend cycle meetings to learn new products and campaigns

skills.expectation: Call on doctors on the master call list and detail products with scientific literature
Convert doctors to prescribe the brands and check uptake through chemist prescription audits
Visit chemists and stockists so the brands are stocked and orders are booked
Explain composition, dosage, benefits and side effects for the assigned therapy area
Plan the headquarter and outstation territory so every listed doctor is covered each month
Meet monthly primary and secondary sales targets for the territory
File daily call reports, tour programmes and expenses in the company app on time
Hold short, clear product conversations with busy doctors and chemists
Follow the pharma marketing code on samples, gifts and medical events
Use a pharma CRM to log calls and plan visits
Estimate monthly territory sales by brand
Keep a simple sheet of doctor coverage and brand sales
